units: metres, kilograms, radians (range_deg: degrees), newton metres
conventions: link i frame = DH frame i-1, joint i turns about its z axis; q = 0 is the standby pose (PAR6's standby pose); PAR6/RCB DH angles theta = q + theta_offset, not wrapped

joints.name: base_joint
joints.range_source: lower: measured stop; upper: the same angle mirrored (the CAD has no J1 stop; not measured)

joints.name: shoulder_joint
joints.range_source: lower: measured stop (CAD sweep -83.0); upper: CAD sweep

joints.name: elbow_joint
joints.range_source: lower: measured, the forearm lying limp on the upper arm (the CAD parts meet at about -77); upper: measured stop (CAD sweep 92.5)

joints.name: wrist_1_joint
joints.range_source: lower: measured stop (CAD sweep -154.0); upper: CAD sweep

joints.name: wrist_2_joint
joints.range_source: lower: CAD sweep; upper: measured stop (CAD sweep 117.5)

joints.name: wrist_3_joint
joints.range_source: lower: CAD sweep; upper: measured stop (CAD sweep 147.5)

joints.name: trigger_joint
joints.range_source: lower: measured stop, trigger released; upper: trigger flush against the handle (CAD)

actuation.note: armature, friction and damping are estimates, not measured

j2_spring.note: zero-free-length cable spring; the model's tendon stiffness 0 = not fitted
